issues.message: Implementing a custom `X509TrustManager` is error-prone and likely to be insecure. It is likely to disable certificate validation altogether, and is non-trivial to implement correctly without calling Android's default implementation.
issues.reason: 组合 manager 逐一调用系统/随包CA checkServerTrusted，全部失败继续抛 CertificateException；不是空实现或 trust-all。调用者未替换默认主机名验证。旧 Android trust-chain/所有外部服务矩阵尚未覆盖。

issues.message: Insecure Base Configuration
issues.reason: 应用本机DSH及用户主动LAN功能需要HTTP，base cleartext保持开放；官方更新/下载域名单独deny HTTP。该边界不能保护所有第三方HTTP，LAN流量确实未加密，界面已明确说明。
